name: Addon Submission Blocker for Gravityforms
author: Ishor Ale Magar

sections.description:
The Addon Submission Blocker for Gravityforms plugin allows you to block specific email addresses, domains, IP addresses, and even custom text content from submitting forms. This is particularly useful for reducing spam and unwanted submissions. Additionally, it provides a convenient way to block problematic entries directly from the Gravity Forms entry list and detail pages.

Features:

  • Block specific email addresses.
  • Block all email addresses from specified domains (e.g., gmail.com).
  • Block submissions from specific IP addresses.
  • Block specific text content within any form field.
  • Set custom validation messages for blocked submissions.
  • Easy-to-use settings page integrated with Gravity Forms.
  • Clear instructions and a user-friendly interface.
  • Option to block IPs, emails, domains, or text directly from Gravity Forms entry list and detail pages.

Usage:

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Forms > Settings > Submission Blocker.
  3. Add email addresses, domains, IP addresses, or text content to block (one per line).
  4. Customize validation messages as needed.
  5. Save changes and enjoy spam-free forms!
  6. To block an entry directly: Navigate to Forms > Entries. Hover over an entry in the list and click “Block”, or view an entry’s details and find the “Block Submission” option in the sidebar. Select the value and type to block (IP, Email, Domain, or Text) and confirm.

License

Support

For support, please open an issue on our GitHub repository.Lv2 or later. See GPLv2 for details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/addon-submission-blocker-for-gravityforms directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to **Forms > Settings > Submission Blocker to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Can I block email addresses from specific domains?

Yes, you can block all email addresses from a specific domain by adding the domain (e.g., gmail.com) to the Blocked Domains section.

What happens when a submission is blocked?

The form will display a custom validation message, which you can configure in the plugin settings.

Does this plugin work with all forms on my site?

This plugin only affects forms created using Gravity Forms.

How do I customize validation messages?

Go to the plugin settings under **Forms > Settings > Submission Blocker, and you can customize the messages displayed for blocked emails, domains, IPs, and text.

Can I block specific words or phrases?

Yes, you can add specific words or phrases to the “Blocked Text” section in the plugin settings. Submissions containing any of these will be blocked.

How do I block an entry directly from the entries page?

Go to Forms > Entries. You’ll see a “Block” link when you hover over an entry in the list. Clicking it, or the “Block Submission” option on the entry detail page, will take you to a page where you can select the IP, email, domain, or text from that entry to block.

1.5.0

  • New Feature: Added option to block specific text content within form fields.
  • New Feature: Implemented direct blocking of IPs, emails, domains, and text from Gravity Forms entry list and detail pages.
  • Improved security and nonce verification for all form processing.
  • Enhanced input sanitization and output escaping for all user-provided data.
  • Added internationalization support for all user-facing strings.

  • Added “one per line” instructions in the settings.
  • Added custom validation messages for all block types.

1.3.0

  • Added the ability to block email domains.
  • Added the ability to block IP addresses.

1.2.0

  • Added a settings page under Gravity Forms.

1.1.0

  • Initial release with basic email blocking functionality.

1.0.0

  • Initial plugin scaffolding.
